We’re kicking off this week’s Green Deals with a bunch of ongoing savings from last week’s big event alongside some newer deals. Leading the group is Segway’s GT3 Electric SuperScooter down at its $1,400 low for the rest of the week, not to mention the other models in the sale. We also have an exclusive bundle for Anker’s expanded 6,144Wh SOLIX F3000 Portable Power Station with an expansion battery and FREE home integration kit ($100 value) down at $2,118 , as well as the Autel MaxiCharger AC Pro 80A Level 2 EV Charger back at its $909 low , the Greenworks 80V 20-inch Cordless Pole Hedge Trimmer kit at a new $243 2026 low , and GoTrax’s MK2 Electric Mini Motorbike for kids at a new $280 low – plus, several ongoing sales/deals from last week’s Prime Day event. You can also find the hangover deals from last week collected together in our latest Electrified Weekly roundup edition here .
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Segway’s more advanced GT3 electric superscooter at $1,100 under the Pro model, now at $1,400 low (Reg. $1,700)
As part of Segway’s ongoing Fall Deals Day Sale that is continuing Prime Day savings for another week, you can currently score the Segway GT3 Electric SuperScooter down at $1,399.99 shipped at Amazon, beating the direct website’s pricing by $100 . While it is listed with a $1,900 MSRP directly, at Amazon it only ever goes as high as $1,700, with most the discounts we’ve seen this year dropping it to $1,500, though both June and October’s Prime Day events have seen it dip to the $1,400 low instead. You’re getting a total $300 markdown off the going rate ($500 off the MSRP), which comes in $1,100 under the latest GT3 Pro SuperScooter , scratching your thrill-seeker itch without burning a hole through your finances.
You can learn more about this electric scooter here , or browse the entire sale lineup here for the rest of the week.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Anker’s 6,144Wh expanded F3000 power station bundle + FREE $100 home integration kit down at exclusive $2,118, more
As part of Anker’s ongoing SOLIX Fall Prime Deals Encore Sale that is continuing for a few more days, you can find the 6,144Wh F3000 Portable Power Station with an expansion battery and a FREE Power Saver Kit ($100 value) down at $2,118.49 shipped , after using our exclusive code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout. This deal beats out Amazon’s pricing by $82 , not to mention gives you the FREE $100 bundled Power Saver kit. During the two Prime Big Deal Days savings last week, this bundle dropped to $2,060, with the extended sale offer here being the next-best price since July began, giving you $482 combined exclusive savings ($582 total including the free gear) off the going rate. You can also find the standalone 3,072Wh station down at $1,329.99 shipped , after using the above code, beating out Amazon by $70, or browse the full sale lineup here while it lasts.
You can learn all about this bundle’s capabilities in our original coverage here .
Autel’s MaxiCharger AC Pro level 2 EV charger provides 80A output (70 miles each hour) for a $909 low ($390 off)
Amazon is currently offering a better-than-Prime Day deal on the Autel MaxiCharger AC Pro 80A Level 2 Residential EV Charger back down at $908.65 shipped , beating out the direct website by $130 . Down from $1,299, we’ve seen discounts in 2026 taking the cost down between $1,069 and $909, with last week’s Prime Big Deals Day event only seeing it priced at that higher discounted rate. Now, for anyone who held off then, you can score a $390 markdown for the all-time lowest price we have tracked.
You can learn all about the details and features of this EV charger here .
Greenworks’ 80V 20-inch cordless electric pole hedge trimmer hits new $243 2026 low ($107 off), more from $95
Over at Amazon, you can find the Greenworks 80V 20-inch Cordless Electric Pole Hedge Trimmer with a 2.0Ah battery discounted to $242.58 shipped , after clipping the on-page coupon, beating out the brand’s direct website that is keeping it up at a $350 full price. Discounts this year have largely kept the price between $272 and $300, while there was a dip to $250 at the end of September. Last week’s Prime Day event saw it keep to $297, which is where the deal starts here before the on-page coupon adds another $54 savings to the mix ($107 total savings), landing it at the best price we have tracked in 2026.
You can learn all about this pole hedge trimmer or browse the other hedge trimmer and pole saw deals here .
GoTrax MK2 electric mini motorbike is a cool ride for kids at a new $280 low (Reg. $350)
Amazon is currently offering a new low price on the GoTrax MK2 Electric Mini Motorbike for kids 8+ down at $279.99 shipped , beating out the brand’s direct website where it’s still sitting at a $350 full price. This is a new kid-friendly ride that hit the market at the top of August, with the three previous discounts we’ve seen on it since being falls to $314, and last week’s fall further to $297 during Prime Day. The deal here is even better, giving you a $70 markdown off the going rate for a new all-time low price.
You can learn about this kid-friendly electric mini motorbike in our original coverage here .
Lectric’s Better-Than-Prime Sale cuts XPeak2 off-road e-bike bundle to new $1,299 low, more from $799 (ends tonight)
Bluetti’s Encore Sale brings back winter-ready Pioneer Na(Sodium) power station at exclusive new $665 low, more from $499
Yozma’s IN 10 Pro electric dirt bike is back at an exclusive $1,699 low ($700 off) + IN 10 model at $999 ($600 off)
